answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 31992 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: 1-can we give sadqa to saddat family. 2-can we use sadqa money to buy computer for school n pakistan. Question: 1-can we give sadqa to saddat family. 2-can we use sadqa money to buy computer for school n pakistan. Answer ID: 31992 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 815/L=294/tl=1432) (1) It is not right to give the amount of zakah, sadqah al-Fitr or other wajib sadaqat to persons belong to the Prophet’s family. However, you can give them nafl sadaqah. (2) By sadaqah if you mean zakah or sadqah al-fitr, it is not lawful to buy computer from this money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
